thread:
sylvie: quick ping 1 PR #478 for optimize-toolkit edits ready for review. I swapped a couple of examples to v2 but didn't touch quant docs yet. can someone own that?
tony: I can take quant + links. Which links are bad?
sylvie: two: /docs/optimize/quant-profiles -> 404 and the python example notebook link points at the old examples repo. left comments in the PR.
jack: also noticed YAML example still uses `auto_batch: true` and the SDK snippet is `createClient()` 1 both need v2 forms. i'll update the SDK snippet if nobody else is on it.
maya: I'll scan for other `auto_batch` occurrences and open a tiny follow-up PR for sweep.
tony: For quant schema change, current runtime now prefers `profile: { type, bits }` instead of flat `quant_type`/`bits`. I'll add a migration block with a side-by-side YAML example.
sylvie: Side-by-side would be great. users land on that page a lot. can you put a note about the deprecation window too?
tony: yes, added: "runtime accepts legacy shape for 14 days after this update". also fixed the internal link to the new example repo: github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-examples
jack: pushed SDK snippet update to the branch. new JS sample:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us-west-2' });
await client.optimize.createQuantProfile({
  model: 'llama-2-13b',
  profile: { type: 'q4_0', bits: 4 }
});
```
maya: That looks good. For batching I changed YAML to `batching.enabled: true` and adjusted recommended defaults in the note (max_batch_size: 64, max_latency_ms: 40).
sylvie: Nice. One small ask: can we include a tiny TTL change note for caching example? I think the example used 7200s in one place.
jack: Good catch. caching TTL should be 300s in examples. Pushed commit with TTL fix.
docs-ci: Preview for PR #478: https://docs-preview.internal/pr/478 1 checks passed (staging).
sylvie: Going to squash and merge once someone gives one tech + one docs review. @tony can you do tech? @maya docs?
tony: Doing a quick read. looks good from my side. LGTM for quant edits.
maya: LGTM from docs side. small nit on wording in the migration table (made a tiny edit).
sylvie: Merged PR #478 at 1770124990. thanks team :rocket:
